description: This Python script generates a Kconfig file for PetaLinux based on recipes and package information, including functions for writing files, running sanity checks, and parsing recipe data from bitbake outputs.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Appends a string to the output Kconfig file.

methods.name: sanity_test
methods.description: Runs a bitbake command to verify the Kconfig setup.

methods.name: rename_dir
methods.description: Renames a directory if it exists.

methods.name: kconfig_recipe_format
methods.description: Formats recipe data into Kconfig menu entries.

methods.name: get_exclude_pkgs
methods.description: Reads exclude package patterns from a JSON file.

methods.name: plnxkconfig
methods.description: Main function to generate the Kconfig file based on recipes and package data.

methods.name: register_commands
methods.description: Registers the command-line interface for this script.
